title: Implement and manage authorization mechanisms: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: Which authorization model and enforcement path decides this action?
focalInsight: PDP decides from policy/context; PEP enforces; model choice controls who/what changes access.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Access Control
nodes.definition: Access is permitted or denied by evaluating explicit rules against request conditions.
nodes.decision: Define rule scope, precedence and conflict behavior; maintain rules as resources and conditions change.
nodes.failureExample: An obsolete allow rule still exposes an administrative port after a network change.
nodes.detail: Access is permitted or denied by evaluating explicit rules against request conditions.

altSummary: PDP decides from policy/context; PEP enforces; model choice controls who/what changes access.
textFallback:
Authorization: permission decision. Decision: evaluate action/context Failure/example: authenticated but unauthorized user
RBAC: role→permission. Decision: define role lifecycle Failure/example: role explosion
Rule-Based Access Control: Access is permitted or denied by evaluating explicit rules against request conditions.. Decision: Define rule scope, precedence and conflict behavior; maintain rules as resources and conditions change. Failure/example: An obsolete allow rule still exposes an administrative port after a network change.
MAC: label/clearance policy. Decision: enforce mandatory rule Failure/example: owner cannot override
DAC: owner discretion. Decision: manage grants Failure/example: uncontrolled sharing
ABAC: attribute policy. Decision: validate freshness Failure/example: stale department attribute
Risk-Based Access Control: risk/context decision. Decision: step-up/deny threshold Failure/example: impossible-travel ignored
Policy Decision Point: policy evaluator. Decision: return permitted/denied Failure/example: unavailable PDP
Policy Enforcement Point: action gate. Decision: fail safely/log Failure/example: PEP bypass
